-- DDL script

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "id" BIGINT NOT NULL,
  "is_active" BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  "email" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inactive', 'pending')),
  "roles" TEXT,
  "balance" DECIMAL(20, 0) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  "avatar" BYTEA,
  "metadata" JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "orders" (
  "id" BIGINT NOT NULL,
  "user_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,
  "total" DECIMAL(20, 0) NOT NULL,
  "placed_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "events" (
  "event_name" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  "payload" JSON
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ASYNC "uq_users_email" ON "users" ("email");

CREATE INDEX ASYNC "idx_orders_user" ON "orders" ("user_id");

-- Warnings
[MANUAL] users.is_active: TINYINT(1) is mapped to boolean by convention; values outside 0/1 would not be represented and require review.
[MANUAL] users.status: ENUM is not supported by Aurora DSQL; mapped to text with a CHECK constraint. ENUM ordering semantics are not preserved.
[MANUAL] users.roles: SET has no lossless mapping in Aurora DSQL; mapped to text. Multi-value set semantics must be handled in the application.
[MANUAL] users.id: AUTO_INCREMENT column 'id' produces monotonic keys that cause hot partitions in Aurora DSQL; the integer key was kept. Consider a UUID/random key or a cached identity.
[MANUAL] orders.id: AUTO_INCREMENT column 'id' produces monotonic keys that cause hot partitions in Aurora DSQL; the integer key was kept. Consider a UUID/random key or a cached identity.
[MANUAL] orders: Foreign key constraints (fk_orders_user) are not supported by Aurora DSQL and were removed from the DDL. They are preserved as referential metadata; enforce referential integrity in the application layer.
[UNSUPPORTED] events: Aurora DSQL requires every table to have a primary key. Add a primary key (e.g., a UUID/random key) before migrating the table.
[UNSUPPORTED] trg_users_audit: Triggers are not supported by Aurora DSQL and are not auto-converted. Reimplement the trigger logic in the application or with event-driven processing.
[UNSUPPORTED] sp_recalc_totals: Procedural stored procedures/functions are not auto-converted. Reimplement them as LANGUAGE SQL functions or move the logic to the application.
